scope: new exploratory prospective simulation, not M5 or real-v5 re-promotion
seed_selection: new unused confirmed by main-branch code search; no replacement after first opening

random_cell.grouping: sampled unique cell_id KFold shuffled random_state=0

standardized_isotropic_l2.scaler: StandardScaler fit only on fold training data

comparisons.consensus: same identical sharp state or abstain; unavailable if either unavailable

known_effort_upper_bound.extra_covariate: log(sampled-cell sampling_effort), simulation-privileged but not suitability or process-state truth
known_effort_upper_bound.knockout: retain known_effort covariate in all full and process knockouts
known_effort_upper_bound.estimand_note: different representation universe; safety sensitivity not like-for-like identification accuracy against no-effort ODO

full_system_gate.score: spatial or random-cell cross-validated balanced presence/background log score

state_rule.knockouts: every registered carrier in the named process closure removed together, other ecological features retained
state_rule.classifier: frozen classify_process_state then identical closure abstention
state_rule.numerically_invalid: unavailable or unresolved as appropriate, never sharp

oracle.open: after sha256-hashed finite receipt persisted, never used by learner
oracle.state_meaning: approximate occurrence-distribution information state conditioned on simulator observation effort, not causal biological-process truth

primary_estimands: both learners authorized across all 18 cases by split
positive ODO-state recovery under effort-unavailable baseline versus nonlinear-pair among all ODO positives
stable sharp coverage across all declared process cells
secondary_estimands: effort-known upper-bound sensitivity separately per learner pair; cannot claim like-for-like oracle accuracy because effort feature changes process information universe
per-world results incl interaction and observed confounding
random-cell vs spatial contrast within each identical world+seed
single-learner HGB and Random Forest performance, descriptive only

barriers.pilot: old seed 91001 allowed in a clearly development-only smoke; 92001-92003 never opened before source hash and final CI

analysis_limits: HGB and RandomForest are both nonlinear but NOT capacity-equivalent; leaf budgets, ensembling and learning objectives differ
agreement does not imply independent errors because same occurrence/background and observation effort
observation-effort covariate is privileged from simulation and not generally measured in GBIF; effort-known results are only diagnostic bounds
simulator oracle reference is approximated and deliberately abstains under observation confounding; generating membership is a separate notion
6 worlds × 3 seeds is not sufficient for general plant ecology validation
DO NOT compare raw M5 71/80 or fresh-v5 16/300 as same estimand
activation: burned-seed smoke + tests; exact source SHA receipt; only then one-shot fresh seed opening and independent no-refit audit
